item.grandline.grappling_hook.desc: From your deck, throw at a ship within 24 blocks: the lines haul both hulls alongside for boarding. Thrown at another ship of yours (a prize) it rigs a tow line. Sneak-use to cut the lines.
key.grandline.gun_orders: Gun Crews: Fire at Will / Hold Fire
grandline.naval.hook_need_ship: Stand on your ship's deck to throw a grappling hook.
grandline.naval.hook_miss: The hook falls short — aim at a ship's hull within 24 blocks.
grandline.naval.hook_refused: That ship isn't fair game here.
grandline.naval.hooked: Hooks bite into the %s's rail — haul away!
grandline.naval.towing: Tow line made fast to the %s.
grandline.naval.grappled_by: Grappling hooks! The %s is hauling you alongside!
grandline.naval.rammed: RAMMED the %s %s! (%s hull damage dealt, %s taken)
grandline.naval.out_of_shot: The gun crews are out of shot!
grandline.naval.no_command: You must be aboard a ship you command.
grandline.naval.crew_beaten: The %s's crew is beaten — board her to take the ship!
grandline.naval.captured: You captured the %s! Tow or sail her to a shipwright to sell her or refit her as your own.
grandline.naval.customised: The shipwright's crew repaint and re-rig the %s.
grandline.naval.prize_claimed: Refitted and renamed: the %s joins your fleet.
grandline.sea.marine_squadron: A Marine squadron of %s ships is closing in!
grandline.sea.hq_squadron: Marine Headquarters has sent a squadron of %s warships after you!
